definitions.explanation: the transfer of an employee to a different position, department, or location within the same company

examples.japanese: {配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Be transferred to a different position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{企画部|きかくぶ}→企画部：27613_kikakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was transferred from the sales department to the planning department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧{配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: I was suddenly ordered to transfer due to company circumstances.

notes:
JAPANESE EMPLOYMENT:
{配置転換|はいちてんかん} is common in Japanese companies, especially those with lifetime employment practices.

TYPES:
- {部署異動|ぶしょいどう} - department transfer
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧ - transfer to another location
- ⟦{出向|しゅっこう}→出向：07110_shukkou⟧ - secondment to another company

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧ - order a transfer
- {配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - be transferred
- {配置転換|はいちてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - request a transfer

FORMS:
{配転|はいてん} is sometimes used as a short form.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧ - personnel changes
- {転属|てんぞく} - transfer (military/organizational)
